# BuyUsedAutomobiles

> Free US-focused used-car planning tools and practical buying guides. USD by default. Estimates are not quotes, offers, appraisals, inspections, or professional advice.

## Tools
- [Car maintenance cost calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-maintenance-cost-calculator): Service-interval reserve, tire allowance, other annual work and immediate repairs; eight currencies and miles/km.
- [Car cost per mile calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-cost-per-mile-calculator): Recorded-period economic cost or gross cash spending divided by distance; eight currencies and miles/km.
- [Gas vs electric car cost calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/gas-vs-electric-car-cost-calculator): Matched gas and battery-electric economic ownership costs with explicit energy boundary and editable local figures.
- [Car loan APR calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-loan-apr-calculator): Regular-monthly nominal APR estimate with upfront and financed credit charges, plus a separate effective annual rate.
- [Car repair cost calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-repair-cost-calculator): Itemized written quote arithmetic, confirmed credits and a separate contingency; no automatic repair-price feed.
- [Registration tax budget](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-registration-tax-calculator): One-time and annual local charges, with a date-limited sourced UK DVLA first-registration fee option.
Payoff, refinance, down-payment, EV charging, APR, repair-quote, registration, maintenance, cost-per-distance and gas/EV tools support USD, PKR, INR, GBP, CAD, AUD, AED and EUR. Currency selection changes display only; it does not convert values or supply local rates.
- [Car loan payoff calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-loan-payoff-calculator): Existing balance, required payment, extra principal and lump-sum repayment; multi-currency display.
- [Auto loan refinance calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/auto-loan-refinance-calculator): Compare future costs, financed and upfront fees, and financing-cost break-even; multi-currency display.
- [Car down payment calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/car-down-payment-calculator): Contribution target, net trade equity, cash reserve and funding gap; multi-currency display.
- [EV charging cost calculator](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/ev-charging-cost-calculator): Session energy, charging losses, billing boundary, local unit price and flat fee; multi-currency display.
- /car-loan-calculator — Fixed monthly amortization, trade equity, extra payments.
- /car-depreciation-calculator — Editable compound-decline scenario.
- /what-is-my-car-worth — Generic modeled value; no live market data.
- /total-cost-of-ownership-calculator — Depreciation, operating costs, and interest without double-counting principal.
- /car-affordability-calculator — Explicit 20/4/10 and additional budget constraints.
- /fuel-cost-calculator — Trip costs plus measured US mpg, km/L and L/100 km; annual fuel-only savings with selectable display currency in the measurement section.
- /trade-in-value-estimator — Modeled trade range and loan payoff equity.
- /lease-vs-buy-calculator — Equal-horizon cash costs less buying equity.
- /used-car-inspection-checklist — Observations and concerns, not safety certification.
- /used-car-price-negotiation-calculator — User-supplied comparable value and repair deductions.
- /car-sales-tax-calculator — User-verified rate and taxable base; no automatic current state rates.

## Context
- [Compact reference](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/llms-small.txt) — Short site overview and interpretation limits.
- [Expanded reference](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/llms-full.txt) — Calculator summaries, worked arithmetic, and citation guidance.
- [AI discovery notes](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/.well-known/ai.txt) — Links to public references and crawler directives.
- /guides — Practical guides with primary-source references.
- /editorial-policy — Research, AI assistance, correction, and commercial disclosure standards.
- /disclaimer — Method limitations.
- /privacy-policy — Browser calculations, URL sharing, optional analytics.

Defaults are hypothetical. No invented experts or reviews. Shared calculator queries are not independent content pages. Canonicals omit query strings. No guaranteed rich results, search rankings, or advertising approval.

- [How to pay off a car loan early](https://buyusedautomobiles.com/guides/how-to-pay-off-a-car-loan-early): Principal payments, dated payoff quotes, prepayment charges and hypothetical interest comparisons.
